english.title: Canvassing ancillary credit services off trade premises
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), canvassed off trade premises the services of **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person carrying on a business of

(A)_[credit brokerage]_
(B)_[debt-adjusting]_
(C)_[of debt-counselling]_
(D)_[the provision of credit information services]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 154 of, and Schedule 1 to, the Consumer Credit Act 1974.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Twelve months imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time Limit on Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
